main_body: Two lower cheese wheels side by side, with a smaller wheel stacked on top. All are yellow cylinders with lighter top surfaces.
top_band: Light yellow top surface on the upper wheel, about rows 4-7. Another light yellow band across the two lower wheels, about rows 9-11.
evidence: Reading down the middle column of the top wheel: a light yellow top band, a pale front-edge line, a dark brown shadow row under the overhang, then a mid-yellow front face. The lower wheels repeat this, with a light top band of about 3 rows over a front face of about 3 rows and a dark brown base shadow. The tops read as horizontal surfaces above the front faces, in a blocky polygonal ellipse. This is a three-quarter view, with no thin-rim or flat-elevation failure.

style.evidence: The yellow ramp has only about 3 steps: a light top, a mid face and a dark shadow. The dark brown outline is tinted to the material, which is acceptable. The wheel faces are flat yellow areas of about 5x3 px or larger, with no rind grain, holes or speckle. Each tile carries about 3-4 colours, against the richer cheese stall and well references, so the piece looks thinner and flatter next to them.
